name: agent-city
description: A city of agents that builds software end-to-end from one command (/city). The Mayor orchestrates; the executive agents execute: city-engineer (writes code), city-inspector (writes + runs tests), city-courier (opens + stewards the GitHub PR), city-archivist (provisions a database when needed). Every run keeps a resumable, reviewer-auditable ledger on the feature branch. The pipeline loops until the pull request passes — and never merges to main.
